estimate.armNotice: ARM (Graviton · Ampere) instances require your app to be ARM (aarch64) compatible — you may need to recompile and verify dependencies.
estimate.sudNote: (sustained use discount not applied — up to {pct}% off automatically if run all month)
estimate.commitNotice: {years}-year commitment prices (no upfront) — AWS EC2 Instance Savings Plans and RDS/ElastiCache reservations, Azure reservations, GCP committed use discounts (CUDs). Commitments apply only to VM, K8s node, DB, cache and container compute; storage, traffic, CDN, logs, load balancers, NAT and K8s control planes stay at on-demand prices. Committed charges are billed for the whole term whether or not you use them.
estimate.footnote: Linux on-demand list prices (or the selected commitment prices) × 730 hours/month. Per-account free allowances not included. The arrow (→) marks the cheapest instance that satisfies your specs, matched automatically. Storage compares general-purpose SSDs (gp3 · Premium SSD v2 · Balanced PD) and standard object tiers; traffic uses tiered internet-routing rates.
